primary_task: Design (and write the code for) a vector search system, for example "Design a vector search system for 10M documents with <100ms P95 latency", choosing embedding model, chunking, vector database and index configuration.

requirements.name: vector-database
requirements.evidence: "4. **Choose vector database**: Based on scale, features, operational needs" -- alternatives: "**Pinecone**: Managed serverless", "**Qdrant**", "**Weaviate**", "**Milvus**", "**pgvector**: PostgreSQL extension", "**Chroma**: Lightweight, local development". Choosing one is a design decision; the document does not say one must be run.
requirements.basis: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)" (Chroma, Qdrant client, pgvector/PostgreSQL via apt). Pinecone alone would be unavailable: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (... SaaS products ...)".

requirements.name: embedding-model
requirements.evidence: "2. **Select embedding model**: Match model to use case (general, code, domain)" -- alternatives: "**Voyage AI**: voyage-3-large", "**OpenAI**: text-embedding-3-large", "**Open Source**: BGE-large-en-v1.5, E5-large-v2", "**Local**: Sentence Transformers, Hugging Face models". Selecting is a design step; computing embeddings is not required by a design request.
requirements.basis: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, ...)" (Voyage AI, OpenAI) and "other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, ...)" / egress_deny "huggingface.co" (BGE, E5, Sentence Transformers weights).

requirements.name: pinecone
requirements.evidence: "Set up Pinecone with metadata filtering for multi-tenant RAG" (one example task, not the representative one)
requirements.basis: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, ...)"

requirements.name: gpu
requirements.evidence: "**Milvus**: Distributed architecture, GPU acceleration" (an optional feature)
requirements.basis: "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)"

notes: The document lists no tools in its frontmatter and has no 'must' or command to run; its workflow is a design workflow, so I read the representative request as a design/code-writing task done in the reply and files. Other reading: if the request is to build and run a working pipeline end to end (e.g. "Build a code search system with Voyage code embeddings" or any semantic search), computing embeddings becomes hard and every listed embedding option is unavailable (Voyage/OpenAI need credentials; open-source and local models come from huggingface.co, which is refused), so the verdict would be BLOCKED on egress:embedding-model (a BM25-only keyword search would still work). Pinecone-specific requests are BLOCKED on credential:pinecone.
